name: @synapsepay/web
description: Synapse Pay for websites: a hosted card field, 3-D Secure and terminal checkout. Works with any framework.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/synapsepay.esm.js && esbuild src/global.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --minify --outfile=dist/synapsepay.js
